name: OnChip Devices
old_description: OnChip Devices, Inc head-quartered in Santa Clara, CA is a global leader in Integrated Passive Devices. With an advanced silicon fabrication facility and strong partnerships with full turn-key assembly houses in Asia, OnChip is offering state-of-the-art silicon and ceramic solutions for High-brightness LED, Computing and Consumer Electronics.
about:
OnChip Devices, Inc. is headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company operates an advanced silicon fabrication facility and maintains partnerships with full turn-key assembly houses in Asia.

The company manufactures Integrated Passive Devices (IPDs) that combine resistors, capacitors, and diodes on a monolithic silicon substrate, as well as Thin Film and CMOS components. Its capabilities include wafer services, testing services, and 100% visual inspection of wafers or bare die performed to MIL-STD-883 Method 2010 using low- and high-power microscopes. Inspection covers defects such as embedded foreign material, metallization voids, contamination, surface scratches, and dicing defects. Services are offered at wafer level or after dicing in waffle packs or gelpaks.

OnChip serves the high-brightness LED, computing, and consumer electronics markets. Its devices are used in handsets, notebook PCs, MP3 players, and printers. The inspection services meet commercial, military, and medical electronics specifications.

The company states that its integrated approach enables design engineers to reduce component size for miniaturization, optimize performance through superior high-frequency and low-noise characteristics, lower total system cost by reducing part count, improve design cycle time, and improve reliability.
